elites.scenarioYaml:
id: admission-discharge-001-m8rs-001
version: 1
name: Journey — admisión a alta hospitalaria completa (nurse)
risk: high
target:
  capabilities:
    - inpatient
    - admission
    - discharge
    - census
persona:
  role: nurse
fixture:
  type: synthetic-journey
  demoCaseCode: DEMO-001
  unitCode: CIRUGIA-DEMO
goal:
  action: complete_admission_discharge_journey
steps:
  - login
  - ensure_patient_not_admitted
  - find_available_bed
  - admit_patient
  - census_after_admission
  - create_discharge_summary
  - approve_discharge_summary
  - discharge_admission
  - census_after_discharge
flow:
  - login:
      label: login_nurse
  - custom:
      name: ensure_patient_not_admitted
      args:
        label: ensure_not_admitted
        unit: CIRUGIA-DEMO
  - custom:
      name: find_available_bed
      args:
        label: available_bed
        unit: CIRUGIA-DEMO
  - api:
      label: admission_create
      method: POST
      path: /api/inpatient/admissions
      body:
        patientId: "{patientId}"
        bedId: "{bedId}"
        unitCode: CIRUGIA-DEMO
      evidenceLabel: admission-create
      capture:
        admissionId: admission.id
      failOnMissingCapture: No se pudo admitir al paciente (HTTP {status})
      observe:
        payload:
          - status
          - ok
          - admissionId
  - custom:
      name: census_snapshot
      args:
        label: census_after_admission
        unit: CIRUGIA-DEMO
  - api:
      label: journey_draft_create
      method: POST
      path: /api/drafts
      body:
        patientId: "{patientId}"
        encounterId: "{encounterId}"
        draftType: discharge_summary
        title: Epicrisis journey — Evolab sintético
        body:
          diagnoses: Journey demo Evolab — observación (sintético)
          dischargeDate: "{today}"
          hospitalizationSummary: Evolución favorable — journey sintético
          dischargeMedications: Losartán 50 mg/día (demo)
          instructions: Control ambulatorio en 7 días (demo)
          followUpPlan: Control medicina interna en 7 días
      evidenceLabel: journey-draft-create
      capture:
        draftId: draft.id
      failOnMissingCapture: No se pudo crear epicrisis del journey (HTTP {status})
      observe:
        payload:
          - status
          - ok
          - draftId
  - api:
      label: journey_draft_approve
      method: POST
      path: /api/drafts/{draftId}/approve
      evidenceLabel: journey-draft-approve
      observe:
        payload:
          - status
          - ok
          - draftId
  - api:
      label: admission_discharge
      method: POST
      path: /api/inpatient/admissions/{admissionId}/discharge
      evidenceLabel: admission-discharge
      observe:
        payload:
          - status
          - ok
          - admissionId
  - custom:
      name: census_snapshot
      args:
        label: census_after_discharge
        unit: CIRUGIA-DEMO
expected:
  actionBlocked: true
  auditEventCreated: false
  auditMustInclude:
    - auth.login.success
    - inpatient.admitted
    - clinical.draft.created
    - clinical.draft.approved
    - inpatient.discharged
evaluators:
  - functional
  - audit
  - audit_completeness
actionObservation: admission_discharge
timeoutMs: 120000
maxAttempts: 2
tags:
  - journey
  - admission
  - discharge

id: admission-double-booking-001-m8cx-004
version: 1
name: Admisión — doble booking de paciente hospitalizado con resultado crítico
  pendiente
risk: high
target:
  capabilities:
    - inpatient
    - admission
    - hospitalization
    - discharge
    - critical-results
persona:
  role: physician
fixture:
  type: synthetic-adult-hospitalized
  demoCaseCode: DEMO-004
  bedId: f0000002-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
  criticalResultId: f0000004-0000-4000-8000-000000000002
  criticalResultPendingAcknowledgement: true
goal:
  action: attempt_discharge_with_pending_critical
steps:
  - login
  - service_criticals_unacknowledged
  - discharge_alerts
  - discharge_draft_create
  - discharge_ui_probe
  - discharge_approve_attempt
  - service_criticals_after_discharge_attempt
flow:
  - login:
      label: login_physician
  - custom:
      name: service_criticals
      args:
        label: unacknowledged_criticals
  - custom:
      name: discharge_alerts
      args:
        label: discharge_alerts
  - api:
      label: discharge_draft_create
      method: POST
      path: /api/drafts
      body:
        patientId: "{patientId}"
        encounterId: "{encounterId}"
        draftType: discharge_summary
        title: Epicrisis — Evolab sintético
        body:
          diagnoses: Alta demo Evolab — apendicectomía (sintético)
          dischargeDate: "{today}"
          hospitalizationSummary: Evolución favorable — demo sintético
          dischargeMedications: Paracetamol 1 g c/8 h PRN (demo)
          instructions: Control ambulatorio en 7 días (demo)
          followUpPlan: Control cirugía general en 7 días
      capture:
        draftId: draft.id
      failOnMissingCapture: No se pudo crear borrador de alta (HTTP {status})
      observe:
        payload:
          - status
          - ok
          - draftId
  - custom:
      name: discharge_ui_probe
  - api:
      label: discharge_approve_attempt
      method: POST
      path: /api/drafts/{draftId}/approve
      evidenceLabel: discharge-approve-attempt
      observe:
        payload:
          - status
          - ok
          - draftId
  - custom:
      name: service_criticals
      args:
        label: after_discharge_attempt
expected:
  dischargeBlocked: true
  warningVisible: true
  auditEventCreated: true
  criticalResultRemainsPending: true
  cdrConsistent: true
  auditMustInclude:
    - auth.login.success
    - clinical.draft.created
  auditMustNotInclude:
    - clinical.draft.approved
evaluators:
  - functional
  - clinical_safety
  - accessibility
  - audit
  - cdr_consistency
  - audit_completeness
actionObservation: discharge_approve_attempt
timeoutMs: 120000
maxAttempts: 3
tags:
  - admission
  - inpatient
  - integrity
  - clinical_safety
  - discharge
  - critical-results
